tags.name: Equipment
tags.tooltip: Target equipment: Pump or Fan

tags.name: FaultType
tags.tooltip: Injected fault label, exactly as defined in cfg.faults

tags.name: Severity
tags.tooltip: Injected fault severity D, fraction 0..1

tags.name: RPM
tags.tooltip: Shaft speed, within cfg.operating.speed_rpm_range

tags.name: LoadFraction
tags.tooltip: Load fraction 0.3..1.0 (cfg.operating.load_pct_range / 100)

tags.name: AmbientC
tags.tooltip: Ambient temperature, within cfg.operating.ambient_C_range

tags.name: ITLoadKW
tags.tooltip: IT heat load 10..100 kW (adapter design bound)

tags.name: Run
tags.tooltip: True = adapter advances the simulation one tick per tick interval

tags.name: ResetSeq
tags.tooltip: Increment to reset the simulation history (new trajectory)

tags.name: Connection
tags.tooltip: CONNECTED while the adapter posts; BACKEND DISCONNECTED after a clean stop

tags.name: InjectedEquipment
tags.tooltip: Equipment the injected fault was applied to

tags.name: InjectedFault
tags.tooltip: Fault that was INJECTED (ground truth of the simulation)

tags.name: PredictedFault
tags.tooltip: Fault PREDICTED by the trained classifier (independent of InjectedFault)

tags.name: Severity
tags.tooltip: Injected severity D actually simulated, fraction 0..1

tags.name: VibrationRMS
tags.tooltip: Vibration RMS from extract_vibration_features

tags.name: CurrentRMS
tags.tooltip: Motor current RMS from extract_mcsa_features

tags.name: HealthIndex
tags.tooltip: Health Index 0..100 from compute_health_index

tags.name: RULValid
tags.tooltip: False when estimate_rul has no degrading trend (RUL then NOT available)

tags.name: RULHours
tags.tooltip: RUL in simulated hours; meaningful only when RULValid is true

tags.name: RULHistoryPoints
tags.tooltip: Number of history points behind the RUL estimate (small = provisional)

tags.name: CoolingEffectiveness
tags.tooltip: cooling_effectiveness_from_degradation output, 0..1

tags.name: ServerTemperatureC
tags.tooltip: Server inlet temperature from thermal_digital_twin

tags.name: ThermalMarginC
tags.tooltip: T_safe minus server temperature

tags.name: MaintenanceState
tags.tooltip: maintenance_decision_engine level (5 states)

tags.name: MaintenanceReason
tags.tooltip: First reason string from the decision engine

tags.name: SimTimeHours
tags.tooltip: Simulated time in hours (NOT wall-clock time)

tags.name: LastUpdate
tags.tooltip: Gateway time of the last accepted post (any kind)

tags.name: Heartbeat
tags.tooltip: Adapter loop counter, increments every poll

tags.name: LastCommandResult
tags.tooltip: OK, or REJECTED/ENGINE ERROR with the reason

tags.name: StaleAfterSeconds
tags.tooltip: Telemetry older than this is shown as BACKEND DISCONNECTED
